source_format.name: MXFP8_E4M3FN
source_format.legal_nonzero_block_invariant: the frozen max_abs/448 block quantizer makes the maximum normalized element magnitude 448, so the block element-reference exponent is 8

element_decode.sign_handling: one sign sideband; zero has canonical positive sign

temporal_alignment.block_scale_exponents: beta_x and beta_w are decoded integer base-2 exponents; their wire encoding is an M2 decision
temporal_alignment.channel_reference_exponent: E_max = max_b E_raw[b] over nonzero candidate blocks
temporal_alignment.fine_delay: lambda_x[k] = 8 - e_x[k] for a nonzero activation element
temporal_alignment.constant_reference_exponents: the activation and weight element-reference exponents are both 8; their sum is a common factor and therefore is not added to E_raw or stored per block
temporal_alignment.all_zero_block_policy: kill; no element exponent or arrival is evaluated for numeric work
temporal_alignment.all_zero_dot_policy: set E_max to canonical zero, return accumulator zero, and clear overflow
temporal_alignment.runtime_weight_metadata: only beta_w contributes to D; no weight element exponent or per-block weight-reference exponent is decoded online

schedule_to_target.target_fraction: for R > 0, retain the R most-significant bits of normalized_significand_integer[2:0] and clear the remaining low bits
schedule_to_target.target_significand: for R > 0, A_sig_int = 8 | target_fraction; A_sig_int is unsigned UQ1.3
schedule_to_target.zero_rule: R == 0 or x == 0 produces an invalid/zero target and no numeric contribution
schedule_to_target.sign_rule: activation sign remains a one-bit sideband and is applied to the full product
schedule_to_target.issue_rule_owner: the M2 microarchitecture config owns acceptance and issue timing; M1 defines one numeric multiply for an accepted nonzero target

activation_target_fraction.description: the three explicit E4M3 fraction positions after prefix clearing

activation_significand.description: multiplier magnitude operand; activation sign is a separate sideband

offline_weight_encoding.rounding: round to nearest, ties to even, symmetrically for negative values
offline_weight_encoding.overflow: unreachable for finite E4M3FN; the exact rounded range is [-112, 112] inside signed 8 bits
offline_weight_encoding.element_order: increasing k within increasing b, c, and projection order declared by the artifact

arithmetic.multiply: multiply unsigned 4-bit UQ1.3 A_sig_int by signed 8-bit Q6 W_aligned_int, then apply the activation sign; retain the full signed 12-bit Q9 product
arithmetic.temporal_alignment: for an active element, P_temporal_int = P_element_int << (28 - tau); this common-tail integer is a bit-exact oracle for time-domain placement, not a runtime activation barrel shift
arithmetic.block_reduce: sum up to 32 signed temporally aligned products exactly in signed 45-bit Q37
arithmetic.accumulate: sign-extend each block sum and add in block-index order in signed 52-bit Q37
arithmetic.accumulator_overflow: saturate after each update to the signed 52-bit range and set a sticky overflow flag
arithmetic.legal_input_overflow: unreachable for at most 4096 legal source elements

frozen_software_boundary.software_semantics: NAF-prefix truncation of the activation-weight element product using the original MXFP8 weight
frozen_software_boundary.hardware_semantics: binary prefix formation over the three normalized activation fraction bits, one standard multiply by the offline-aligned 8-bit weight, and placement at temporal arrival tau
frozen_software_boundary.equivalence_claim: none except for explicitly verified vectors; frozen quality and executed-digit evidence retain their original provenance and do not include the new 8-bit aligned-weight rounding
